description: Score convergence: a deterministic 0–100 measure of the distance between a stated task (intent) and the actual git diff (execution), with sub-scores for Coverage (did the intent happen?), Scope (did only the intent happen?), and Risk alignment (did unrequested drift land on risk-sensitive paths?). No model. A task that predicts no owner file is band inconclusive, with no score. Emits a recomputable receipt (a hash anyone can regenerate). Requires a base git ref to diff against; scores the working tree's tracked changes unless head or staged selects an exact subject.

base.description: Git ref to diff against (e.g. origin/main, HEAD~1). Required.

head.description: Score exactly base..head instead of the working tree; the receipt binds to the head commit. Cannot be combined with staged.

includeMarkdown.description: Return a compact human-readable markdown report instead of the full JSON. Defaults to false.

includeUntracked.description: Working-tree mode only: also score untracked, non-ignored files. Defaults to false; untracked files are otherwise listed under untracked and not scored.

intent.description: Declared intent from change_impact declare (record, JSON, or path): score against the declared files instead of a live prediction.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

query.description: The stated task / intent to measure against the diff, e.g. "add Stripe refunds".

staged.description: Score only the Git index; the receipt binds to its tree.

top.description: Number of predicted owner files to consider. Defaults to 10.

name: convergence_score
title: Convergence Score
